description: This line plot, titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = small," illustrates the evolution of Word Error Rate (WER) across six epochs for four different fine-tuning methods applied to a small Whisper model. The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis represents WER, scaled linearly from 25.0 to 42.5, with grid lines and tick marks at 2.5-unit intervals. Four distinct lines are plotted: a solid orange line with square markers for "small AdaLoRA_int4," a dashed orange line with circle markers for "small AdaLoRA_int8," a solid orange line with diamond markers for "small int4," and a dashed orange line with square markers for "small int8." The "small AdaLoRA_int4" line starts at a WER of 35.5 at epoch 0, rises to a peak of 42.5 at epoch 2, then declines to 30.0 at epoch 6. The "small AdaLoRA_int8" line begins at 30.0, rises to 32.5 at epoch 1, then declines to 25.0 at epoch 6. The "small int4" line starts at 30.0 and steadily decreases to 25.0 by epoch 6. The "small int8" line begins at 30.0, dips to 27.5 at epoch 3, then rises slightly to 26.0 at epoch 4 before falling to 25.0 at epoch 6.
